title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 16, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 11:08 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 447 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic electrons are elevated around Earth! 🛰⚡💡🌞

A prominent elongated coronal hole crosses the southern-central disk alongside two visible active regions; no clear large outward structure appears in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
